summary: Copa Holdings filed a Form 6-K with its second-quarter 2026 earnings release. The filing reports operating profit of $91.7 million, net profit of $68.2 million ($1.67 per share), and a $1.71 per share dividend ratified by the board, paid September 15, 2026. It also mentions Starlink fleet installation and hub schedule changes. This is a routine earnings and corporate update, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, spin-off, restructuring, or any other change-of-control or catalyst-driven transaction is disclosed. The filing is an ordinary issuer report under Rule 13a-16.
